fullPassage: People who work in emotional caregiver roles, such as psychiatrists and nurses, are expected to empathically handle their patients’ issues whatever they may be. But as they continue to immerse themselves in the emotional suffering of their patients, these professionals may gradually be overwhelmed by the cumulative weight of the pain they witness day in and day out. The constant exposure to trauma or negative emotions can erode their emotional resilience, thereby making them susceptible to anxiety, depression, and even physical fatigue. The key to dealing with these conditions is for caregivers to regularly monitor their own emotions. Recognizing that they are vulnerable to the effects of repeatedly having to be compassionate will allow them to seek the care they need. Implementing proactive self-care strategies can help people providing care to others be more effective in their jobs.

③ (A) 핵심, 비결 (B) (악기의) 건반: 스트레스 완화의 '핵심' + 피아노 '건반' ←정답

④ (A) 잠그다 (B) 건반: (A)는 명사 '핵심'이에요
det.tip: key: 문제 해결의 '핵심' vs 피아노 '건반'.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the capacity to recover quickly from difficulties and return to a stable emotional state"

det.korean: fatigue=피로 / exposure=노출 / trauma=정신적 외상 / resilience=회복력
det.analysis:
① fatigue: 피로 — 지친 상태라 '회복 능력'과 달라요

② exposure: 노출 — 무언가에 드러나는 것이라 달라요

③ trauma: 정신적 외상 — 상처 자체라 회복 능력이 아니에요

④ resilience: 회복력 — 어려움에서 빠르게 회복하는 능력 ←정답
det.tip: recover quickly from difficulties → 회복력(resilience).

questions.passage: Implementing proactive self-care strategies can help people __________ (provide) care to others be more effective in their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: provide → providing: 바로 앞 people을 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사(-ing)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'can help people __________ care to others(남에게 돌봄을 ______ 사람들)'에서 빈칸은 앞의 people을 꾸미는 분사 자리예요. people이 능동적으로 '돌봄을 제공하는' 것이니 provide를 현재분사 providing으로 바꿔요.

→ 따라서 provide를 providing으로 써요.
det.tip: people providing care = 돌봄을 제공하는 사람들 (현재분사 수식).

questions.passage: But as they continue to immerse themselves in the emotional suffering of their patients, these professionals may gradually be __________ (overwhelm) by the cumulative weight of the pain they witness day in and day out.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: overwhelm → overwhelmed: 'may be + p.p. + by'는 수동태라 과거분사로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'these professionals may gradually be __________ by the cumulative weight'는 'be동사(be) + ______ + by'로 수동태예요. 전문가들이 고통의 무게에 '압도되는' 것이니 overwhelm을 과거분사 overwhelmed로 바꿔요.

→ 따라서 overwhelm을 overwhelmed로 써요.
det.tip: be overwhelmed by = ~에 압도되다 (수동태).

questions.passage: People who work in emotional caregiver roles, such as psychiatrists and nurses, are expected to empathically handle their patients’ issues whatever they may be. But as they continue to immerse themselves in the emotional suffering of their patients, these professionals may gradually be overwhelmed by the cumulative weight of the pain they witness day in and day out. The constant exposure to trauma or negative emotions can erode their emotional resilience, thereby making them susceptible to anxiety, depression, and even physical fatigue. The key to dealing with these conditions is for caregivers to regularly monitor their own emotions. Recognizing that they are vulnerable to the effects of repeatedly having to be __________ will allow them to seek the care they need. Implementing proactive self-care strategies can help people providing care to others be more effective in their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: compassionate=동정심 있는 / careless=부주의한 / dishonest=부정직한 / distant=냉담한
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞뒤 '반복적으로 ______해야 하는 것의 영향에 취약하다'가 단서예요. 돌봄 종사자가 환자에게 거듭 보여야 하는 자세예요.

① compassionate: 반복적으로 '동정심을 내야' 하는 것이 부담이 돼요 ←정답

② careless: 부주의함은 돌봄 역할과 안 맞아요

③ dishonest: 부정직함은 문맥에 안 맞아요

④ distant: 냉담함은 공감 돌봄과 반대예요
det.tip: repeatedly having to be ______ → 동정심 있는(compassionate).

questions.passage: People who work in emotional caregiver roles, such as psychiatrists and nurses, are expected to empathically handle their patients’ issues whatever they may be. But as they continue to immerse themselves in the emotional suffering of their patients, these professionals may gradually be overwhelmed by the cumulative weight of the pain they witness day in and day out. The constant exposure to trauma or negative emotions can erode their emotional resilience, thereby making them susceptible to anxiety, depression, and even physical fatigue. The key to dealing with these conditions is for caregivers to regularly monitor their own emotions. Recognizing that they are vulnerable to the effects of repeatedly having to be compassionate will allow them to seek the care they need. Implementing proactive self-care strategies can help people providing care to others be more __________ in their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: harmful=해로운 / effective=효과적인 / invisible=보이지 않는 / temporary=일시적인
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞뒤 '선제적 자기 돌봄 전략이 돌봄 종사자가 업무에서 더 ______이도록 돕는다'가 단서예요.

① harmful: 해로운 — 돕는다는 흐름과 반대예요

② effective: 자기 돌봄이 업무에서 더 '효과적'이게 해줘요 ←정답

③ invisible: 보이지 않는 — 문맥에 안 맞아요

④ temporary: 일시적인 — 긍정적 결과와 안 맞아요
det.tip: help ~ be more ______ in their jobs → 효과적인(effective).
